items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: That's about the first time I ever saw Piku.

ctx.x: So how does Bolton fit into this?

Now, let me show you. Well, Frank Deucin. I was a kid, right to separation from the hall to my house, in a big picket fence. So I and a bunch of boys hanging around the corner. How old were you? Huh? Oh, around about 12. So, me living next to the hall. The fellow used to run it. Called him, uh, John Shailis. He was a manager. So I'd ask him. I said, John said, let me sweep up the hall. All right, you sweep up the hall. And in the night time, he'd leave me going in the hall. So I'd take him down about two or three…
